newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Emperor Int'l receives general offer.
newsitem.headline: Emperor Int'l receives general offer.

text.p: Emperor International Holdings Ltd said its single largest shareholder is interested in making a general offer for the company.

Emperor said in a statement published on Friday that it had received a proposal from its largest shareholder Charron Holdings Ltd on April 30 that would involve a general mandatory general offer for the company.
After receiving the proposal, the company requested that its shares be suspended from trading on April 30, 1997.
The share closed at HK$2.175 on Tuesday.
